sections.name: Safety
sections.desc: Trip logic, permissives, beacons and horn. Runs first in every scan.

rungs.comment: Analog sensor fail (4-20 mA broken wire reads below -5 %): TT-201, LT-101, LT-102, LT-201
Trip causes: E-stop, power loss, gas HH, over-temperature, over-pressure, sensor failure
Trip latch - sets on any cause
Trip reset - only when every cause has cleared (reset-last priority)
Conveyor line fault: motor overload or jam
Alarm horn follows unacknowledged critical alarm
Beacon green = plant running and healthy

sections.name: Sequence
sections.desc: Plant start/stop, Auto/Manual, and the main batch state machine (SEQ_STEP). Step transitions are written highest step first so only one step is taken per scan.

rungs.comment: Derived values: syrup target = batch kg x syrup % / 100
Derived: pasteurization hold time in ms
Derived: fill time in ms = ml x 4 ms/ml
Derived: minimum temperature for a valid pasteurization hold = SP - 3
Order complete when packed cans reach the order target
Plant run latch: SET by Start (Auto, healthy, order not done)
Plant run latch: RESET by Stop, trip, Manual mode or order done
Step 80 production: product exhausted (pasteurizer and filler bowl empty) for 3 s
Step 70 hold: temperature must stay >= SP-3 for the whole hold time (timer restarts otherwise)
Step 60 heat-up: at temperature for 3 s
Step 50 transfer: mixing tank empty for 1.5 s
Step 10 pre-check: tanks have material, mixer empty, room in pasteurizer
Step 10: load recipe temperature into the loop setpoint
Batch counter (counts every entry into step 20)
Abort batch: back to step 0 (process drains product)

sections.name: Tanks
sections.desc: Syrup (T-101) and water (T-102) tank level control with hysteresis, inlet valves and empty detection.

rungs.comment: Syrup tank refill latch: start below LT_LOW_SP
Syrup tank refill latch: stop above LT_HIGH_SP or on trip
Syrup inlet valve XV-101 (auto level control or manual)
Syrup tank empty (LL) - dry-run protection for P-101
Water tank empty (LL) - dry-run protection for P-102
Filler bowl empty (LL) - inhibits filling valve

sections.name: Mixing
sections.desc: Batch dosing by weight: syrup (step 20), water (step 30), agitator, mixing time (step 40) and transfer to the pasteurizer (step 50).

rungs.comment: Syrup pump P-101: step 20 until syrup weight reached; interlocks: overload, tank empty
Syrup dosing valve XV-103 (opens with pump)
Water pump P-102: step 30 until batch weight reached
Agitator M-103: steps 30-50, only when there is liquid in the tank
Transfer pump P-103: step 50, pasteurizer not full
Dosing fault bit for the alarm server

sections.name: Heating
sections.desc: Pasteurizer heater contactor and the temperature PID loop (steps 60-80). Loop can be put in manual from the HMI.

rungs.comment: Heater contactor K-201: needs liquid over the element and temperature below the HH limit
Temperature PID: PV=TT-201, output = heater power %

sections.name: Filling
sections.desc: Filler bowl feed pump, filling and capping stations. Each station: sensor -> request -> timer -> done latch (reset when the can leaves).

rungs.comment: Filler bowl feed request: start below 55 %
Filler bowl feed request: stop above 90 %
Filler station request: can present, not yet filled
Can filled -> latch done (releases the conveyor)
Filled latch resets when the can has left the station
Capped latch resets when the can has left

sections.name: Conveyor
sections.desc: Conveyor motor M-401 with VFD speed control, stop-and-go while any station is working, empty-can infeed.

rungs.comment: Conveyor hold while filler, capper or labeler is busy
Conveyor motor run: auto in step 80 (not held), or manual command
Empty-can infeed gate opens while the conveyor runs
VFD speed reference = speed setpoint x run bit

sections.name: Inspection
sections.desc: Camera inspection (fill level, cap present, product temperature) and reject pusher RP-401.

rungs.comment: Reject pusher pulse (0.6 s) on a FAIL result edge

sections.name: Packaging
sections.desc: Labeler, label verification + reject, carton packing with can counting, and barcode scan counter.

rungs.comment: Labelled latch resets when the can has left
Label verification FAIL -> reject pusher RP-502 pulse
Counter: good cans delivered to the packer (order progress)
Cans-per-carton counter (preset from recipe); reset by CTN_RST
Carton full -> reset the can counter one scan later (or new order)

sections.name: Palletizing
sections.desc: Palletizer robot, cartons-per-pallet counting and stretch wrapping.

rungs.comment: Wrap finished (falling edge) -> pallet counter and reset carton count
Reset cartons-on-pallet at wrap end or new order

sections.name: Housekeeping
sections.desc: Clears momentary HMI command bits at the END of the scan so every rung has seen them exactly once.

sfc.title: Main plant sequence (GRAFCET)

steps.name: PRE-CHECK
steps.act: Check tank levels; load recipe setpoint

steps.name: DOSE WATER
steps.act: P-102 + XV-104 + agitator until batch weight

steps.name: HOLD
steps.act: Hold temperature for the recipe time

sfc.note: Abort (M_ABORT) returns to step 0 from any step. Trip / Stop freezes the step; Start resumes.
